name: flow-stream
description: A stream of dots through a pipe of stages that dims and brightens, with entry and exit markers.

parameters.name: inbound
parameters.description: label on the arrow that comes in, or None

parameters.name: outbound
parameters.description: label on the arrow that leaves, or None

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: colour of the dots and the boxes

returns: VGroup with .nodes, .stream (.fade_to(level), .brighten(), .stop()), .entry, .exit; add it, then play the stream's animations as the narration moves on
